_comment: Capability floors for scripts/capability-floor-audit.py (ADR 0114, issue #933). Each entry names the commit that first shipped a capability in this canonical contract that a consumer's generated caller must include for the org to treat the capability as universal. A consumer pin that is not a descendant of `introduced_at` is stale for that capability's generators.

capabilities.description: gate-rearm.yml, ai-review-merge.yml, and ai-privileged-merge.yml/ai-promotion-retry.yml accept "deepseek" as a review provider. A pin predating this commit fails closed with "unsupported review provider" once an org variable resolves to deepseek. AI_REVIEW_PRIMARY_PROVIDER moved to deepseek org-wide on 2026-08-16, which is what turned this into a live outage in toquorum and verjson-authn.

The changelog generator can emit the standalone pr-gate caller that publishes the literal changelog-contract check required by the canonical Node ruleset rollout (#731). A pin predating this commit makes generated-only adoption impossible.

The changelog contract accepts Renovate's default source-link suffix in a fragment body (#927). A pin predating this commit rejects otherwise-valid dependency-update fragments with that suffix; this contract-shape change applies regardless of fragment author and is not driven by an org variable. The shape was observed in Verjson/verjson-cli-cloud's then-current renovate-changelog.yml (issue #977).
